design_rules: Design every future clothing, accessory, and trait first on side_front_point as the master trait mannequin.
Adapt the same item to every active runtime sheet; do not create separate clothing designs per pose.
Resize and reposition the same item to match pose scale, body angle, facing direction, and limb position.
Quick or rare poses such as side_front_victory and side_front_dance may use simplified placement if needed.
Common/core poses, especially side_front_point and side_front_wave, require stronger consistency.
If side_front_victory or side_front_dance read smaller in runtime, try role-level scale normalization first; if quality suffers, keep them rare-only and regenerate only if consistency breaks.
